name: my-news-reader
description: A retro desktop-style news reader: one Cloudflare Worker, KV storage and a D1 database.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: A long random password for maintenance calls (you can leave it empty; you run the reader from your own account).

TYPESAFE_API_KEY.description: Optional. A key from TypeSafe AI (Jev) to sort stories by topic and place. Leave empty to sort by the built-in keyword rules.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. A Resend key for sign-up and password-reset email. Leave empty and no email is sent.
